name: 85225 · Chandler, AZ
findings: ZIP 85225 (Chandler) has 151 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 60 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85225 (Chandler) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
49% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 1 social and fraternal organization here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.
